FN-QNGIA41-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 541
Committee: Ethics and Campaign Finance Sponsor: Representative Ernie Yarbrough
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/10/2026
House Bill 541 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Office of the Secretary of
State by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to the office to revise the voter
application form, store and retain voter history information, and to adopt rules to implement the
provisions of this bill regarding the registration of electors to a political party affiliation.
This bill could also increase the obligations of the boards of registrars by an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost to store and retain voter history information and to process party
affiliation changes.
